title: Secret Life+
description: Allows admins to add a customisable apocalypse to secret life with Mat0u5's Life series mod.
body:
# Info:
Ever been playing Secret life but noticed something missing? Well look no further! Introducing Secret Life+, the addon that you didn't know you needed!

## What is added:
An easy way to add a Boogey curse or Secret Society integrated through tasks that will happen whenever you want! This allows for customisation, such as what session you want it to happen in, what kind of task you want it to be and which of the 2 you want to select!

## Instructions:
- Use /trigger session set <number> in order to select which session you wish for the event to happen in. Default is session 6.

- Use /trigger difficulty set <number> in order to set the difficulty of tasks the curse will have. 0 for easy, (default) 1 for hard, 2 for red.

- Use /trigger type set <number> to choose between the boogey curse and the society. 0 for disabled, (default) 1 for boogey curse, 2 for society.

- Use /function secretlife:info while in creative to see the startup message again.

**IF IT IS NOT WORKING:** run /function secretlife:load

## Notes:
> I'm a guy who makes datapacks, not mods. I still have no idea how commands work, so you're stuck with using /trigger for now.
